notes: Adjudicated labels for the 16 preregistered questions. The preregistration file stays unverified. verified here means the relevant set was checked against stored comment text and collection status. It does not mean retrieval succeeded. relevantSourceIds lists every stored row that supports the question. An empty array is a verified empty set. realCorpus stays not_run.
windowPolicy: Answerable questions use the inclusive span of stored comment event_time values on that target. event_time is updated_at. The span includes same-target comments that were judged not relevant, so the window is the stored discussion rather than the subset that retrieves best. It does not use created_at or the parent snapshot updatedAt. Verified-empty questions have no supporting comment or review event_time. Their probe window is the span of stored event times on that target, including the snapshot updatedAt when no comment exists or when the snapshot falls outside the comments. A probe window tests abstention. It is not a claim that the snapshot time is a comment time.
